about: TDM-56 [6.2] labels for the understander eval, written by hand from reading each repo BEFORE any model run. Scored on kind + benchable (post-code verdict); driver_type and outcome are reported too. github is the repo the digest names; local is the checkout the live eval ingests (the jaximus808 repos are private or local-only, see docs/findings/understander.md).
